fact: Recommended Blue Swallow Guesthouse to Luis in July 2025; Joana Ferreira, who runs it, is a friend of Rita's cousin.
Lives in Lisbon above the pharmacy with the green cross that never switches off; July is her busiest month for work.

Her aunt lives in Cacilhas, up the hill from the ferry, in the blue house opposite the bakery with the broken clock; she cooked lunch (a bean stew) for Luis and Niamh on Sunday 21 September 2025 and drinks her tea with milk. They took the 11:50 ferry from Cais do Sodre, meeting Rita at the newspaper kiosk at 11:30.
The Blue Room cost €115 a night, €575 for the five nights of 18-23 September 2025 with breakfast; Luis paid a €172.50 deposit in August and €402.50 at check-out. Duarte helps her in the mornings.
On 25 September 2025 she sent the invoice and a photo of Luis and Niamh on the balcony, and asked for a review on Nightjar Stays.

She and Marc held an engagement party at their place in Toronto on Saturday 25 October 2025; Luis and Niamh didn't fly over (Niamh had a work deadline), planned to join by video at 7pm Toronto time (midnight going into Sunday in London), and Luis said he'd send flowers.

The wedding invitations (150, with gold foil; final file Invitation_final_v6.pdf) were printed by a printer in Chapalita; Luis paid 8,640 pesos (about CA$640) by card on 22 November 2025 as a loan, which upset Daniela until he explained.
Rules for Luis's toast: three minutes maximum, English and Spanish, no stories about her at university. Expected order: her dad, Marc's dad, Luis, then the couple, after the main course.
Kept the wedding airport pickup sheet (the "Airport" tab, column D); transferred the CA$640 to Luis on Thursday 26 March 2026 with the reference "invitations, finally" (arrived 27 March).

Flew to the wedding with Luis on PV 412 London to Mexico City (lands 18:35, Tuesday 14 April 2026) and PV 1170 to Guadalajara (lands 10:05, Wednesday 15 April); Luis's dad collected them and they stayed in his parents' spare room. She chose the vegetarian main and hates coriander.
In October 2025, at Pellam & Rook, she was finishing the Harrow audiobook masters (due 27 October 2025).

The Albion Road carpets were cleaned by Brightpile Carpet Care on 26 June 2026 for £95 (receipt in Luis's email). Niamh found 46 check-in photos dated 3 March 2023 on her old phone backup (three show the bedroom door already marked) and put them in the shared Albion folder.

Before the move the sofa sold for £180 cash on 13 June 2026; the drafting table and bike rack went for £70 on 25 June to the flatmate of her colleague Saoirse, paid into the joint account (Luis's clamp lamp went with the table).

Albion Road deposit: on 27 July 2026 Luis and Niamh offered to settle for £75 (door only); Mr Stavros declined in August. The £340 went to the deposit scheme as case 7731-0485 on 18 August. The 2023 check-in inventory notes "light marks to bedroom door"; the 29 June checkout report says the carpets were "clean, some flattening to pile".
Luis returned the missing Albion Road window lock key (it was on his bike keys) through Halden & Pryce's letterbox on Saturday 22 August 2026; no £45 charge was made.

Proposed a settlement call for Wednesday 21 October 2026 at 2pm, then cancelled it that morning and proposed Tuesday 27 October at 10am because Mr Stavros was unwell; Luis hasn't confirmed the new time.
Asked Luis in July 2026 for Brightpile Carpet Care's number to clean his Flat 1; Luis never sent it.
In June 2026 he was holding two letters for Luis (one looked like HMRC) that had arrived since April; Luis offered to collect them on Saturday 13 June around 10.
Her July 2026 London trip was a university conference plus a week's leave; the second week she stayed in a friend's spare room in Peckham. Luis invited her to dinner at Mallory Road.

Luis asked if Andrei still had the projector from the old Keetons Road film nights and if he could borrow it for Jo's surprise 40th (14 November 2026) on 11 October and nudged on 15 October, with no answer.

Lotte goes to a Kita in Berlin; there's a plum tree in the courtyard of his building. In September 2026 Luis introduced him to Nikhil for a custom typeface; their call was moved from 4 to 8 September because Lotte had a fever.
His Brooklyn employer has a renters' insurance app and wants a custom typeface before its renewal emails go out in November 2026; Luis introduces him to Felix Brandt.

Left a green scarf in the Mallory Road spare room in October 2026; she's staying again from Thursday 29 October (19:30 from Temple Meads, Paddington 21:15) to Sunday 1 November, working at her company's Barbican office on Friday 30 October.

Pennywort's Product Owner for Loyalty, Hannah Lisle, is on parental leave from 31 August 2026 to the end of February 2027; Owen Pratt covers. The three loyalty tiers signed off in June 2026 stay; Marcus booked a walkthrough with Owen for 1 September at 10:00.
The design team's 2026 training budget is £4,800; £3,150 was spent by 7 September 2026, including Kasia's £640 motion course.
In September 2025 he set up a guest login for Ruth Okoro, a freelance researcher on Tandem City for six weeks, who used her own laptop.
